rationale_one_line: OpenMontage is an agentic pipeline, so SCHEMATIC draws the loop; voltagent's deep-space command terminal (emerald on carbon black) matches both the agent-orchestration story and the creator's command-center lineage.
writing_tone_notes: Build-in-public, technical, confident. Show one specific thing per surface. Lead the caption with star velocity, never a version number. Land the 'real footage not stills' thesis once. Contractions where natural.
do_rules: Draw the actual production pipeline as the hero diagram with an orbit camera.
Use the emerald accent only on the highest-signal beats (final node, fix, close).
Keep the terminal beat concrete: a real command, real archive sources, a real result.
dont_rules: No version numbers anywhere (there are no release tags anyway).
Do not repeat the star figure or the exact 'real footage' phrasing across tweet, Gmail, and scenes.
No superlatives doing the praise work. Let the contrast carry it.
